instructions:
1. Set both cable pulleys to a high position and attach a handle to each.
2. Stand in the centre, grasp a handle in each hand, palms facing forward, arms extended up and out to the sides.
3. Stagger your feet shoulder-width apart and keep your back straight.
4. Pull the handles down and together in front of your hips in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
5. Slowly return the handles to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your lower chest as the handles meet at the bottom.
2. Keep your torso upright and core braced to resist leaning.
3. Exhale as you bring the handles together, inhale on the return.
4. Move slowly and keep tension on the chest throughout.

instructions:
1. Set both cable pulleys to the lowest position and attach a handle to each.
2. Stand in the centre, grasp a handle in each hand with an underhand grip, arms extended down and out to the sides.
3. Stagger your feet shoulder-width apart and keep your chest up.
4. Sweep the handles up and together in front of your chin in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
5. Slowly lower the handles back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Focus on squeezing your upper chest as the handles meet near chin level.
2. Keep your shoulders slightly retracted and chest puffed out.
3. Exhale as you raise the handles, inhale on the return.
4. Brace your core to keep your torso stable.

instructions:
1. Set both cable pulleys to mid-chest height and attach a handle to each.
2. Stand in the centre, grasp a handle in each hand, arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height, palms forward.
3. Place one foot in front of the other, knees slightly bent, back straight.
4. Pull the handles together in front of your chest in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
5. Slowly extend your arms back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your chest as the handles meet at the centreline.
2. Keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbows throughout.
3. Exhale as you bring the handles together, inhale on the return.
4. Brace your core to resist the cables pulling you backward.

instructions:
1. Attach a rope to the low pulley of the cable machine.
2. Sit on a chair facing the machine, feet together and flat on the floor, knees bent about 90 degrees.
3. Grasp the rope in both hands and hold it close to your chest for support.
4. Push through your heels and extend your legs to stand up tall.
5. Slowly bend your knees and lower back down to the seated position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through your heels to engage the glutes and quads.
2. Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your spine.
3. Exhale as you stand, inhale as you sit down.
4. Control the descent rather than dropping into the chair.

instructions:
1. Attach a handle to a mid-height pulley on a cable machine.
2. Grasp the handle with your left hand in a neutral grip and step back to create tension.
3. Bend slightly at the hips, back straight, core braced, and tuck your upper arm against your side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
4. Extend your forearm straight back by straightening the elbow, keeping the upper arm still.
5. Slowly return to the start with control, then finish all reps and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the upper arm pinned to your side so only the forearm moves.
2. Squeeze the triceps hard at full extension.
3. Exhale as you extend, inhale on the return.
4. Move slowly to keep tension on the triceps.
